sents.zh: 金朝的时候，很多年轻人开始学汉字。
sents.en: In the Jin dynasty many young people began to learn Chinese characters.

sents.zh: 他们每天很早就去学校。
sents.en: They went to school very early every day.

sents.zh: 老师先教他们读，再教他们写。
sents.en: The teacher first taught them to read, then to write.
One character had to be written many times.
If it was not good, they wrote it again.
Some were still reading in the evening.
Once they had learned the characters, they could work.

sents.zh: 有的人做官，有的人做买卖。
sents.en: Some became officials, some became merchants.
They learned their own writing as well.

sents.zh: 他们说，读书让人有力量。
sents.en: They said that study makes a person strong.
